{{Quote|Massster Horn is correct. The Jedi Order is no thedyklae herd. We are shartuukz.|[[Saba Sebatyne]]|<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>}}
A '''Shartuuk''' was a guard beast that protected the lairs from the "always hungry" [[zo'oxi]] and [[Tarnogg]]s. Shartuuks were known to eat the zo'oxi, which were skin [[Parasite/Legends|parasites]].<ref name="Abyss" />
